faqs.question: How to get a Portugal work visa from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Obtain a compliant Portuguese job offer, prepare documents (often including criminal record), then apply at the consulate. SK packages the file.

faqs.question: Do I need Portuguese language?
faqs.answer: Helpful for many jobs; some international companies use English. We map language realistically.

faqs.question: SK fee for Portugal work permit?
faqs.answer: From PKR 80,000. Authority fees separate. No guarantees.

faqs.question: Is Portugal easier than Germany for work?
faqs.answer: Different rules — not “easier.” Employer compliance and salary thresholds matter. We compare honestly in consultation.

faqs.question: Can family join later?
faqs.answer: Family reunification has separate rules after you hold the right residence status. Ask during consult.

faqs.question: Does SK guarantee Portugal visas?
faqs.answer: No. Portuguese authorities decide every case.

body:
Portugal work permit / work visa from Pakistan

Portugal attracts hospitality, tech and general skilled workers. Strong contracts and proof of means matter; tourist entry is not a work shortcut.

Requirements

  • Portuguese employment contract meeting legal thresholds
  • Passport, forms, photos
  • Qualifications / experience matching the role
  • Criminal record certificate and translations when required
  • Accommodation proof and insurance as requested

Process

  1. Contract eligibility check
  2. Document and translation plan
  3. Consular submission prep
  4. Biometrics and follow-up
  5. Arrival registration briefing

Documents

  • Passport, photos, application form
  • Signed contract and employer details
  • Diplomas and experience letters
  • Police clearance (attested/apostilled as needed)
  • Insurance and fee receipts

Related checklist tool: Open checklist →

Fees

SK from PKR 80,000. Official fees separate.

Timeline

Often 2–5 months after a compliant contract is ready.

Common mistakes

  • Contracts below legal salary thresholds
  • Missing criminal record legalization
  • Using visit visas intending to work
  • Unverified “Portugal job guarantee” agents

Work route reality check for Portugal

Work residence needs a genuine job basis and clean documents.

SK Immigration helps with CV packaging, document checklists and appointment prep. We do not sell fake job guarantees. Employers and missions decide.

Before you pay anyone

  • Confirm the job/contract type matches the visa subclass
  • Language level matches employer expectations
  • Educational documents follow the correct attestation chain
  • You understand SK fees vs medical/government fees
